data.ruling: The refutation does not stand. Its only failed figure is the per-cell floor measured against a +/-75 mV band, and +/-75 mV is not a requirement value. No source on the page sets that band. F9 sets the floor at 3.0 V a cell, read per cell from the balance lead. IOBoard.md (Pack disconnect, Discharge floor) gives no tolerance. The owner marked V95 "for research" (owner, 2026-09-28). V95 asks what tolerance the trip point holds over 0 to 50 degC, which is a property of the part. It does not set a limit for parts to meet. The 75 mV in the requirement text ("F9; V95 found") comes from round 1's finding on the R5460x212AF datasheet (x0.975 to x1.025 at Ta 25 degC only; FU-B1/005-P2-R5.json, FU-B3/002-P2-R5.json). That is another candidate's figure, carried over as a gate. It is not an owner answer and not a specification value. The verifier's reading of the datasheet is correct, and it corrects the figure P2 found for V95. P2's "about +/-54 mV" treats the gain error as a percentage of the reading. The datasheet's unit is /FSR (percent of full-scale range), so P2's figure stands corrected. On the datasheet maxima, the cell-channel error at 3.0 V is about +/-80 mV. That assumes FSR = VFS (about 1.22 V). If FSR spans -VFS to +VFS, the error is wider, about +/-128 mV. The datasheet states no cell-voltage accuracy and no bound limited to 0 to 50 degC. The maxima apply over -40 to 85 degC. This corrected figure is the V95 value to record: 3.0 V is the nominal trip point, and the band is about +/-80 mV. The part still meets the floor. CUV:Threshold is a data-flash value from 0 to 32767 mV in 1 mV steps. A setting of about 3080 mV (3128 mV under the wider FSR reading) makes 3.0 V the lowest trip at every tolerance corner. A production cell-gain calibration (Calibration:Voltage:Cell Gain, data flash 12101) narrows the band, but no figure bounds what is left after it. Every other datasheet and stock figure was confirmed by the verifiers and not disputed.
data.evidence: SLUSBV4D 5.5, re-read 2026-10-02T13:19:20Z (same file as the verifier's read, 2,721,930 bytes). Cell-channel scaling factor K for VC1-VSS and VC2-VC1 is 0.198 / 0.200 / 0.202 (min / typ / max). ADC: VFS = VREF1 (1.215 to 1.225 V at 25 degC). Full-scale range is listed as -VFS to VFS. Gain error is +/-0.2 % typ and +/-0.8 % max, unit /FSR, over -0.1 V to 0.8 x VFS. Gain error drift is 150 ppm/degC. Offset error is +/-67 uV typ and +/-157 uV max. Min/max values apply over TA -40 to 85 degC. The datasheet and TRM SLUUBT5C state no cell-voltage accuracy. The TRM's only cell calibration parameter is Calibration:Voltage:Cell Gain (12101). Arithmetic at 3.0 V with FSR = 1.22 V: K +/-1 % gives 30 mV; 0.8 % x 1.22 V / 0.2 gives 48.8 mV; offset gives 0.8 mV; total about 79.6 mV. With FSR = 2.44 V the total is about 128 mV. Requirement sources, checkout f06c3ae0d570, read 2026-10-02 about 13:10Z: Research.md V95 answer "for research (owner, 2026-09-28)"; F9 answer "floor 3.0 V a cell, read per cell from the pack's balance lead"; IOBoard.md Pack disconnect ("when any cell falls to the 3.0 V floor of F9") and Discharge floor (3.0 V a cell). None states a tolerance in mV. Origin of the 75 mV: round 1 FU-B1/005-P2-R5.json and FU-B3/002-P2-R5.json, both with V95 found "+/-75 mV (2.925 V to 3.075 V) at Ta 25 degC" from the R5460 datasheet NO.EA-165-250616, and both stating that the tolerance over 0 to 50 degC is not stated.
